disposition: A pass authorizes freezing a separate multi-rollout-per-paper training protocol. A support fail stops Stage D live training without threshold changes. Infrastructure and invariant failures follow the frozen v10 matrix and are never silently relabeled as science.

failure_dispositions.future_successors: V10 has no automatic successor. Any v11 or later live campaign requires a terminal review, explicit new user authorization, a distinct preregistration, and fresh observed addresses.
failure_dispositions.ordinary_negative_support: Any well-formed observed topology outside eligibility, including child continuation or later-root child spawning, is durably finalized as denominator-negative with all commitments excluded from replay. It is not retried.
failure_dispositions.post_response_infrastructure: Because the frozen collector is exactly-once and has no resume mode, a demonstrated environment or capacity loss after any response bytes ends v10 after evidence recovery. It is reported as infrastructure, not support or science; observed addresses are never rerun.
failure_dispositions.pre_response_infrastructure: At most one redeployment is allowed for a demonstrated outcome-independent infrastructure failure before any model response bytes. It preserves every scientific and sampling field and requires a committed infrastructure-only amendment.
failure_dispositions.terminal_invariant: Malformed causal provenance, duplicate structural addresses, request-response mismatch after canonical request normalization, transport ambiguity after a request, ledger inconsistency, or any rerun of an address with observed bytes terminates v10.

forward_plan.capacity_unavailable: Make no mutation, spend nothing, and resume this same frozen v10 campaign when qualifying capacity is available.
forward_plan.post_response_infrastructure_failure: Recover and verify all unambiguous evidence, terminate compute, report an infrastructure-terminal v10 result, and do not retry observed addresses or automatically create v11.
forward_plan.pre_response_infrastructure_failure: Recover diagnostics, terminate compute, and use the one bounded redeployment only if the failure is demonstrably outcome-independent.
forward_plan.support_fail: Recover and verify all support evidence, terminate compute, publish the denominator result, and do not start scientific training or alter the support thresholds.
forward_plan.support_pass: Recover and verify all support evidence, terminate compute, use measured eligible-target and token costs to freeze a separately reviewed scientific power and budget plan, and require a fresh explicit launch authorization before scientific model calls.
forward_plan.terminal_invariant: Recover whatever evidence is unambiguous, terminate compute, record the invariant failure, retire every address with observed response bytes, and do not automatically create v11.
